This file is a trimmed extract of upstream `tizen-extension.xml` from the Tizen `wayland-extension` repository, containing only the `tizen_screenshooter` interface (the streaming `tizen_screenmirror` sibling is intentionally omitted from this initial slice). See UPSTREAM.txt for the source commit.

interface.name: tizen_screenshooter
interface.description: Clients can take one-shot screenshots into a wl_buffer they supplied. Only the one-shot subset is wrapped here; the `get_screenmirror` request is omitted from this vendored slice.

request.name: set_oneshot_auto_rotation

description.summary: set screen shot auto rotation value

request.description: Client can set auto rotation value for one shot.

event.name: format
event.description: The tbm format codes match the #defines in tbm_surface.h. The formats actually supported by the compositor will be reported by the format event.

event.name: screenshooter_notify
event.description: Clients can get notification of screenshooter.

request.name: area_shoot
request.description: Client can get area color value.
